LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_TriggerMode_LifeExpectan: Trigger at a share of the race's life expectancy
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_AnimalsUseLifeExpectancy: Animals always use their life expectancy.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_AgeStdDev_Tip: Each pawn's trigger age is offset by a normally distributed amount, so elders of the same age do not all decline at once.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_UntendedSurvivalDays_Tip: How long natural senescence takes to run its course with no care at all. This sets the base daily progression.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_EfficacyHands_Tip: While cared for, daily progression is multiplied by (1 - 0.8 x efficacy). Efficacy also scales the legacy chance.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_EfficacyHerbal_Tip: While cared for, daily progression is multiplied by (1 - 0.8 x efficacy). Efficacy also scales the legacy chance.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_EfficacyIndustrial_Tip: While cared for, daily progression is multiplied by (1 - 0.8 x efficacy). Efficacy also scales the legacy chance.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_BaseCareDuration_Tip: How long one herbal tend lasts. Hands-on comfort lasts 2/3 of this, standard hospice 4/3.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_EnableLegacy: Elders can leave a skilltrainer of their best skill
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_LegacyMinSkill: Minimum skill level for a legacy: {0}
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_SatisfactionMultiplier_T: How fast good care raises the hidden care satisfaction score that decides the passing thought.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_EnableHeartAttack: Severe senescence can trigger a heart attack in pawns with artery blockage
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_HeartAttackChance: Heart attack chance per half day: {0}
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_BionicReduction_Tip: Each artificial heart, lung, liver or kidney slows senescence by this much, up to 50% in total.
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_RespectAgelessGenes: Ageless and non-senescent genes grant immunity
LanguageData.RimLTC_Settings_TargetsAlways: Colonists and slaves are always affected.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_NoCare_Desc: Nobody tends to the elder's senescence. It progresses at full speed, the elder soils their surroundings and they will pass away neglected.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_NoMeds_Desc: Doctors turn, wash and comfort the elder without using medicine. Slows senescence a little, but at best the colony will remember a regretful passing.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_HerbalOrWorse_Desc: Doctors use herbal medicine (or none) to ease pain. Slows senescence noticeably and can earn a peaceful passing.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_NormalOrWorse_Desc: Doctors use industrial medicine (or worse). Slows senescence the most. Together with a comfortable bed and a clean room it can earn a transcendent passing.\n\nGlitterworld medicine is never used for hospice care. Wounds and diseases still follow the medical care policy.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_HeaderTip: Left-click: set the hospice care policy for everyone in this list.\nRight-click: sort.
LanguageData.RimLTC_LegacyProduced: {PAWN_labelShort} has passed on a lifetime of {1} experience. A {2} was left by the bedside.
LanguageData.RimLTC_PassingMessage_RimLTC_NeglectedPa: {PAWN_labelShort} passed away alone, in pain and without care.
LanguageData.RimLTC_PassingMessage_RimLTC_RegretfulPa: {PAWN_labelShort} has passed away. Someone was there at the end, but regrets remain.
LanguageData.RimLTC_PassingMessage_RimLTC_PeacefulPas: {PAWN_labelShort} passed away peacefully, surrounded by care.
LanguageData.RimLTC_PassingMessage_RimLTC_Transcenden: {PAWN_labelShort} completed a legendary life with dignity and without regret. The whole colony is inspired.
LanguageData.RimLTC_CascadeComplication: {PAWN_labelShort}'s failing body could not cope any longer: {1}.
LanguageData.RimLTC_BiosculpterReducedSenescence: The age reversal cycle also eased {PAWN_labelShort}'s natural senescence.
